### 2026-11-06: I wrote the code for jarvis, this code takes in audio input, processes it, turns it into text, sends that text to the ai model, awaits its response, then it speaks out the text using edge-tts, it reli

**9h**

I wrote the code for jarvis, this code takes in audio input, processes it, turns it into text, sends that text to the ai model, awaits its response, then it speaks out the text using edge-tts, it relies almost entirely on a wifi connection, but it does have very simple backup protocols in the case of an outage.
